claims.text: Of 25,095 simulated applicants in the pre-period, 3,994 reached loan disbursal (15.9% start-to-disbursal conversion).
claims.template: Of {started:,} simulated applicants in the pre-period, {disbursed:,} reached loan disbursal ({conv:.1%} start-to-disbursal conversion).

claims.text: The largest drop-off is KYC start → KYC completed: 8,763 applicants lost, 41.5% of all drop-off, with a KYC completion rate of 49.7% among users who started KYC.
claims.template: The largest drop-off is {stage}: {lost:,} applicants lost, {share:.1%} of all drop-off, with a KYC completion rate of {conv:.1%} among users who started KYC.

claims.text: The same stage is the largest drop-off in 13 of 15 segments (device, channel, city tier, week).
claims.template: The same stage is the largest drop-off in {same} of {total} segments (device, channel, city tier, week).

claims.text: Median time from KYC start to KYC completion is 46 minutes; the slowest 10% take over 230 minutes.
claims.template: Median time from KYC start to KYC completion is {med:.0f} minutes; the slowest 10% take over {p90:.0f} minutes.

claims.text: Detecting a 3.0 pp lift from a 49.7% baseline at alpha 0.05 and 80% power needs 4,357 users per arm (statsmodels 4,356.8 vs closed form 4,356.9).
claims.template: Detecting a {mde:.1f} pp lift from a {base:.1%} baseline at alpha 0.05 and 80% power needs {n:,} users per arm (statsmodels {nh:,.1f} vs closed form {ncf:,.1f}).

claims.text: Before simulating, the feasibility check gave the decision guardrail only a 30% chance of passing even with no true harm; the plan was kept and reported, not tuned.
claims.template: Before simulating, the feasibility check gave the decision guardrail only a {p:.0%} chance of passing even with no true harm; the plan was kept and reported, not tuned.

claims.text: The simplified KYC flow raised the KYC completion rate by +4.55 pp (95% CI 3.06 to 6.03 pp; relative lift +9.1%).
claims.template: The simplified KYC flow raised the KYC completion rate by {diff:+.2f} pp (95% CI {lo:.2f} to {hi:.2f} pp; relative lift {lift:+.1%}).

claims.text: Assignment was balanced (8,639 control vs 8,740 treatment; sample-ratio check p = 0.44).
claims.template: Assignment was balanced ({c:,} control vs {t:,} treatment; sample-ratio check p = {p:.2f}).

claims.text: The true planted effect of +4.76 pp lies inside the 95% CI; the estimate is off by -0.21 pp.
claims.template: The true planted effect of {truth:+.2f} pp lies inside the 95% CI; the estimate is off by {err:+.2f} pp.

claims.text: The share of randomized users reaching disbursal rose by +2.24 pp (95% CI 0.97 to 3.51 pp), so the gain survives the credit decision.
claims.template: The share of randomized users reaching disbursal rose by {diff:+.2f} pp (95% CI {lo:.2f} to {hi:.2f} pp), so the gain survives the credit decision.

claims.text: Exploratory: 9 of 11 segment effects remain significant after Holm correction; segments do not drive the decision.
claims.template: Exploratory: {sig} of {n} segment effects remain significant after Holm correction; segments do not drive the decision.

claims.text: Early-delinquent loans per 1,000 randomized users moved by +1.42 (one-sided 95% bound +4.59 vs a +2.1 margin): inconclusive.
claims.template: Early-delinquent loans per 1,000 randomized users moved by {diff:+.2f} (one-sided 95% bound {b:+.2f} vs a +{m} margin): {label}.

claims.text: Per loan, the early delinquency rate changed by -0.04 pp, but the treatment arm disbursed 251.9 loans per 1,000 randomized users vs 229.5, so the per-user count rises mechanically.
claims.template: Per loan, the early delinquency rate changed by {d:+.2f} pp, but the treatment arm disbursed {lt:.1f} loans per 1,000 randomized users vs {lc:.1f}, so the per-user count rises mechanically.

claims.text: Diagnostic guardrails: early delinquency rate pass; approval rate pass (reported, not decisive).
claims.template: Diagnostic guardrails: early delinquency rate {a}; approval rate {b} (reported, not decisive).

claims.text: Across 1,000 simulated A/A tests the false-positive rate was 4.9% (target 5%).
claims.template: Across {n:,} simulated A/A tests the false-positive rate was {fpr:.1%} (target 5%).

claims.text: 95.4% of 95% confidence intervals contained the true effect across 500 replications.
claims.template: {cov:.1%} of 95% confidence intervals contained the true effect across {n} replications.

claims.text: The sample-ratio check flagged the deliberately broken dataset (48.3% treatment, p = 1.1e-05).
claims.template: The sample-ratio check flagged the deliberately broken dataset ({share:.1%} treatment, p = {p:.1e}).

claims.text: Peeking daily and stopping at the first p < 0.05 inflated the false-positive rate to 24.7%, vs 4.7% at the fixed horizon.
claims.template: Peeking daily and stopping at the first p < 0.05 inflated the false-positive rate to {peek:.1%}, vs {fixed:.1%} at the fixed horizon.

claims.text: Cleaning removed exactly the 1,322 injected duplicates and kept all 5,085 legitimate KYC retries.
claims.template: Cleaning removed exactly the {dups:,} injected duplicates and kept all {retries:,} legitimate KYC retries.
